fusions.name: Drawn Out
fusions.desc: Presses a fist of bitter clay into an enemy at or below 25% health for 20 damage, drawing out every affliction on it and adding 1.5 times their remaining damage to the blow.

fusions.name: Quicklime Scatter
fusions.desc: Scatters 4 clods of quicklime at once, each dealing 8 damage that ignores resistances, with a 50% chance to leave the target [Damped], its damage reduced, for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Clay Poultice
fusions.desc: You press bitter clay to your wounds, drawing out up to 3 poisons on you and restoring 12 health.

fusions.name: Mineral Blood
fusions.desc: Your armour rises by 8%, and you carry 15% poison resistance.
